rounds.title: Dhyan Se Chuno

mixup.belief: Thinks 1 and the number itself are not factors
signs: Leaves out 1 and 24 when listing factors of 24

because.rule: shown only to a child the learner model holds this mix-up for, at this beat; any other child gets the script's own board

judge.by: two separate Claude Opus judges (lean, 4 reads), 2026-11-11, renders at b80ed49b7
judge.notes: Screen shows 'SAHI CHUNE 0/9' in round 1 ('30 ke factors'). 30 has 8 factors (1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 10, 15, 30) and the spec sets count 12 with hitRate 0.5. The packet does not show how the engine counts the denominator (repeats? another basis?), so this is not counted as a fault. The packet also does not show whether 1 and the number itself (30, 18, 24) always appear among the 12 falling numbers. lo=1 and hi=a make them possible, and the mix-up targeting depends on them appearing.

judge2.notes: Screen shows 'SAHI CHUNE 0/9' for round 1 ('30 ke factors'). 30 has 8 factors (1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 10, 15, 30) and the spec gives count 12, hitRate 0.5. The packet does not show how the engine gets 9, for example whether numbers can repeat in the stream, so this is not counted. The packet also does not show whether 1 and the number itself (30, 18, 24) actually fall in each round's stream, which is what lets the piece catch the one-and-self mix-up. The range is lo=1 to hi=a, so both are possible.
